title: m-pseudo-coherent object of the derived category of a ring
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, $m\in\mathbf Z$, and $C\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The object $C$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent if there exist a bounded complex $E^\bullet$ of finite free $R$-modules and a morphism $E^\bullet\to C$ in $D(R)$ inducing isomorphisms $H^i(E^\bullet)\to H^i(C)$ for every $i>m$ and a surjection $H^m(E^\bullet)\to H^m(C)$.
